name: empty-states

frames.best_why: Search empty state shows the full anatomy: magnifier, no-results copy, suggestions and two actions.

tagline: Placeholder screens for empty search, chart, inbox and project views.
summary: A set of empty-state panels sharing one framed product surface. Search shows did-you-mean terms and actions, the chart offers a Load sample data button, and other variants cover an inbox, uploads, a project board and activity.
appearance: A dark rounded panel with a small title and meta line in its header, a Clear control at the right, and a centred icon above a heading, a line of grey guidance and one or two pill buttons. A segmented pill bar of six labels sits above; the chart variant draws dashed axes and light grey bars after loading.
behaviour: The pill bar swaps variants with a crossfade. Entrances spring in once as the panel scrolls into view; the chart grows its bars when Load sample data is clicked, and hover or keyboard focus lifts the action buttons and suggestion chips.
demo_content: Search for 'invoices' with suggestions; a 'Weekly active users' chart with Mon-Sun bars and Load sample data.
use_when: A list, chart or inbox can be empty and needs copy, suggestions or a starting action instead of a blank screen.
avoid_when: It is an opinionated dark product panel with fixed internal layouts, so it is heavy for a one-line inline empty message.
customise: Only the variant and className are props; every heading, suggestion, button label and chart value is written inside the per-variant files.
weight_why: Six static panels with one-shot spring entrances and no loops.

a11y.note: Entrances respect reduced motion and buttons have focus rings, but the variant switch is plain buttons without tab roles or aria-selected.

issues: The variant pills look like tabs but expose no selected state beyond colour.
The chart's sample data reads as real data, and its 'sample data only' caveat is tiny grey text.
polish_why: Polished, consistent empty-state kit; the variant tabs and chart caveat are weak points.
